factors: Eight video cues, an unverified maker benchmark, and creator-run cost anecdotes need precise source roles.
Model delegation, unattended permissions and owner authorization create consequential operating boundaries.
complexity.rationale: Extended analysis is appropriate because performance and agent authority claims can influence consequential engineering choices.

sourceMap.rationale: Model choice contrasted with maker recommendations, no universal cost crossover.
Finish line defined before delegation, without independent outcome measurement.
Lead-worker pattern framed as a testable workflow choice.
Long-run effort settings attributed as creator guidance.
Technical access distinguished from owner authorization.
Completion reporting treated as evidence requirement.
Instruction audits framed as judgment rather than universal deletion.
Model switching retained as a source navigation cue.

sourceCoverage.rationale: All eight source cues are mapped to exact sections with qualified automatic-caption provenance; no certified transcript is claimed.

supportingArgument.rationale: Model routing, bounded delegation and authorization form a three-decision argument with counterargument and verdict.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Manufacturer model guidance, creator anecdote and GhostMesh inference are distinguished; no independent benchmark is invented.

counterargument.rationale: The essay explicitly argues coordination can outweigh multiagent benefits and high effort can waste resources.

tradeoffs.rationale: Routing weighs task difficulty, error consequence, context, cost and coordination rather than model prestige.

falsifiability.rationale: A bounded single-model versus delegated run with matched acceptance tests, retries, integration work, time and cost is proposed.

originalSynthesis.rationale: GhostMesh connects model selection with verified outcome economics and distinct owner authority boundaries.

performance.rationale: The 27 versus 58 minute and 58 percent comparisons remain unreplicated creator claims, not generalizable estimates.

economics.rationale: Cost per verified outcome includes retries, coordination and repair; token pricing alone is insufficient.

threatGovernance.rationale: The Reader distinguishes technical permissions and protected owner authorization, and requires inspectable completion proof.

ownerDecision.approval: Tony approved the revised Reader #65 visual and evidence treatment, then gave explicit follow-on publication approval after exact revision 59d1221dfbd568a334dd67e0c0924a90b34f11c4 was identified. Editorial acceptance is distinct from the protected exact-head merge gate.

gaps.rationale: Automatic caption timing and recognition remain uncertain; source audio was not independently certified.
Creator performance and cost demonstrations were not independently reproduced.
Model permissions cannot substitute for owner authorization in protected operations.

decisionRationale: Independent reviewer ACCEPT for exact 59d1221 article bytes, with authorial prose preserved, eight source mappings and source custody retained; Tony approved revised design and publication separately.
